angle: Unlike other L09 materials that construct intervals, this two-minute dialogue teaches confidence intervals purely as an interpretation check by rejecting three wrong readings of a ready-made lunch-cost interval built on a deliberately biased sample.
angle_detail: Start with [00:00]–[00:36] for why the hand-picked sample cannot support claims about all students. Then watch [01:09]–[01:54], where the wrong readings are refused one by one and only the population-mean claim survives. Note the trap: the interval setup at [00:36]–[01:09] names normality and random sampling and then pretends them away, and the sample mean is already known, so use this as a misconception check rather than a methods lesson.
